goal_summary: Let CGKN generate a small usable child project with bounded external Agent help inside the existing reviewed Provider route.

capability_gap.summary: The validated capability brief is available only to support/experimental flow and is not consumed by formal Provider project generation.

selected_items.summary: The kernel permits an external Codex capability supervisor only as bounded advisory support while Provider validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public delivery gate, and delivery manifest remain authoritative.

The reviewed formal generation implementation owns planning, Provider component generation, semantic repair, post-build processing, and evidence handoff. It previously had no validated Codex brief input.
A bounded offline mock-Provider evaluation generated an executable compact FocusForge project, but it did not prove that formal Provider generation consumed the brief.

failure_evidence.summary: Before ITER-027 the formal CLI and execution path had no codex-capability-brief argument, validator call, bounded Provider projection, resume identity check, or checkpoint binding.

A real reviewed-Provider rebuild generated syntactically valid partial files but retained fake Demo parsing, cross-module shape contradictions, excessive leaves, and no materialized candidate, showing that planning and semantic guidance still need a controlled formal-route input.
